title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening for data residency
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS key region residency and ensure audit logs capture explicit region pinning decisions for compliance reviewers. This change closes gaps found during an internal compliance review where KMS selection could implicitly cross-region in a few edge routes and audit events did not include residency metadata. Goals: 1) Enforce KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time (deny if requested KMS key region conflicts with resource residency constraints). 2) Surface residency metadata in audit logs and include the policy decision reason when a request is denied or routed to fallback. 3) Add unit + integration tests and update migration docs. Checklist: - [x] Add policy evaluation hook to RBAC v2 evaluator to check kms_region vs resource_residency - [x] Update RBAC policy schemas + validation messages - [x] Enrich audit events with residency, kms_key_region, policy_rule_id, and decision_reason - [x] Add feature flag for gradual rollout (rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce) - [x] Add integration tests for cross-region key rejection and audit payload validation - [x] Update docs/migration guide for operators - [x] CI and canary deploy on dedicated infra before full rollout Implementation notes: The RBAC v2 evaluator now reads the effective resource residency (from resource metadata or project policy) and compares it against the requested kms_key.region. If the feature flag rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce is enabled and there is a mismatch, the evaluator returns a DENY with a standardized decision_reason code (RESIDENCY_MISMATCH). To keep backward compatibility during rollout, the default is audit-only behavior: when the flag is disabled we emit an AUDIT event and a warning decision_reason but allow the request. Audit events were extended in audit/events.go and the audit Kafka schema (audit.v2.json) to include string fields: residency, kms_key_region, policy_rule_id, decision_reason. Integration tests spin up a local test harness that exercises the dedicated and private control planes using a fake KMS provider that simulates region tags. Migration: Operators with custom RBAC v2 policies may need to add explicit residency constraints or update their KMS key references to include region tags. See docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-region-pin.md for details and rollout steps.

release_notes: Enforce optional KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and harden audit logging to include residency and decision_reason. Feature gated behind rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce (default: audit-only). Operators must review KMS key references and update policies if they want strict enforcement.
migration_steps: Review cluster/operator RBAC v2 policies for implicit KMS key references
Update KMS key references to include region tags where required
Enable rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce behind a canary release in dedicated environments
Monitor audit.kms_residency_mismatch events and address any violations before enabling enforce mode
